planting.note: Plant container-grown shrubs in spring in any well-drained soil; full sun brings the heaviest bloom, though light shade is tolerated.

directions: Jolene Jolene was bred to deliver the beautybush's signature spring display of star-shaped, yellow-throated pink flowers on a rounded frame roughly half the size of the species, making it a better fit for foundation plantings and smaller borders. Branches wreathed in bloom from tip to base in late spring give way to bristly seed capsules that add texture through summer, and the arching habit needs no support once established. Prune right after flowering if needed, removing a few of the oldest stems at ground level every couple of years to keep the base from crowding; established plants shrug off heat and short dry spells with minimal care.
